'''September 2000 San Francisco tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Ballpark Game Center, South San Francisco, CA on 10 September 2000. [[Chris Leung]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-san-francisco-ca-9-10-00d1231/ san-francisco-ca-9-10-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 16 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-san-francisco-ca-9-10-00d1231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Ballpark Game Center, South San Francisco, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Leung]]
